_doc: FIX ROUND 3: every number of how the prison's gunners fight and of how people come, in one place (read by prison_bal.gd; no magic numbers in the code). `ally` = the clear phase's three allies and the people who shoot at the base, `guard` = the tower guards, `squad` = the raid companions. Per role: dmg (a hit, in the dead's hit points: a walker has 4 to 7, a runner 2 to 4, a brute 22 to 30; Ruth's service rifle does 2.2 and her shotgun 5 pellets of 1.3), react (seconds from the first sight of a new target to its first shot), cd (seconds between two shots of one shooter), hit_close and hit_far (the chance to hit at 0 tiles and at far_tiles tiles), moving_pen (taken off when the target walks), head_p and head_mult (a rare head shot does double), focus (most shooters on one target at a time). `rise_wait`: a risen one can be shot only when its rise is over. `zone_together_from`: the index of the first zone whose dead wake all together when one of them is woken (0 is the infirmary, which stays easy). `siege`: a night's wave per segment (4 + 4 x night) is multiplied by min(1, armed / ref_armed) but not below `floor`, armed = the tower guards at their posts (the old 14-person crew had about 6 to 7).
